{"consolidated_memory":"**Leaked field incidents in platform/logging/redact.go**

This component has experienced two separate leaked field redactor issues in the same code area, both manifesting as unmasked values in log lines, but with distinct triggers and root causes.

**Incident 1 [2026-05-22]:**
- File: platform/logging/redact.go
- Problem: Leaked field in the redactor
- Trigger: Two requests raced on the same key
- Signal: Value that should have been masked appeared in log line
- Root cause: Naive datetime compared against an aware one (timezone mismatch)
- Fix: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- PR: #6467 on branch fix/leaked-field-1
- Reproduction: Log the nested payload fixture
- Outcome: Backlog cleared 44 minutes after deploy

**Incident 2 [2026-08-23]:**
- File: platform/logging/redact.go
- Problem: Leaked field in the redactor
- Trigger: Only occurred on first request after a cold start
- Signal: Value that should have been masked appeared in log line
- Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- Fix: Prefetched the relation in a single query
- PR: #7775 on branch fix/leaked-field-2
- Reproduction: Log the nested payload fixture
- Outcome: 96 duplicate rows per day stopped being written

Both incidents share the same symptom and reproduction method but stem from unrelated root causes."}
